candidates.requirement: A successfully copied parsed event must continue to yaml_emitter_emit so the target exercises its parser-to-emitter operation.
candidates.target_route: The entry parses its first stream-start event, copies it, then should emit the original event.
candidates.failure_condition: The stream-start copy initializer returns true, and the entry treats true as a reason to jump to cleanup before emission.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no other emission call or retry path after that jump.

candidates.requirement: The target should continue parsing a flow sequence entry whose key is immediately followed by the closing bracket, reaching the added end-token handling.
candidates.target_route: A flow sequence containing a KEY token followed by its closing token enters the mapping-key state through yaml_parser_parse_flow_sequence_entry, then reaches the added branch.
candidates.failure_condition: The target exits after copying the first stream-start event, before it can parse a flow sequence entry.
candidates.alternative_paths: The entry has no alternate parser call before cleanup; its second parser pass is reached only after the first loop completes.
